messages:
Anya: Quick thread — coordinating Redwood + Triton Systems + NorthBridge SI for EdgeSummit West (booth 314). Need to lock speakers, confirm demo hardware allocation, AV/power, and finalize swag shipping. Can we do a 10am PT sync on Friday?
Matt: We have a 30-min co-present slot on the partner stage and a 60-min dedicated demo window at the booth each day. Friday 10am PT works for me. Who is confirmed to speak?
Ravi: Triton can send 2 DGXbox-2 units and an AV tech for setup. Need 2x 20A circuits and one wired ethernet drop. Also bringing an external NVMe enclosure for the demo dataset.
Sophie: I can take the SI integration portion — 10 min overview + 15 min live demo + Q&A. Need the NVMe and at least 32GB RAM allocated on the demo VM. Prefer a 2nd monitor for slide sync.
Katie: Swag inventory proposal: 200 shirts (S-XL mixed), 500 stickers, 100 co-branded notebooks, 40 demo USBs. ShippingETA: Wed prior to event. I need final artwork by Monday COB to hit print.
Anya: Thanks — action list for Friday: 1) confirm speaker names and order, 2) Triton confirm power/network + shipping tracking, 3) marketing approve artwork + shipping address, 4) events file booth run-of-show.
Ravi: Confirmed: our logistics lead (Diego) will ship directly to the venue address. ETA Wed. I'll send tracking in this thread once it's booked. Power/network request will be filed today.
Matt: Events note — booth run-of-show draft will include: 11:00 demo start, 11:35 quick network Q&A, 12:00 demo reset, 14:00 partner stage walk-through. We'll reserve a 1-hr dry run slot Thurs evening with AV.
Sophie: Can we get a short test dataset (sample logs) uploaded to the NVMe ahead of time? If someone can SFTP it to the demo host on Wednesday that would help.
Katie: Upload instructions to come. Also need size of the demo USB image — are the demo drives >16GB? If so we need different packaging.
Anya: Packaging/packing list (from logistics):
```
- 2x DGXbox-2 units (Triton)
- 1x NVMe enclosure + 1 TB dataset (Sophie)
- AV case + spare HDMI/DP cables
- Swag: 200 shirts, 500 stickers, 100 notebooks, 40 USB demo drives
- Booth signage + co-branded banner (print pickup Thu)
- Power distro, network switch (events team)
```
Matt: Logistics-bot reminder: power/network request submitted to venue (ticket #VS-8892). ETA confirmation 48h.
logistics-bot: Reminder — booth insurance docs required by venue by Tue. Upload link: https://vendor.edge-summit.example/upload
Ravi: Noted — Diego will upload insurance + COI.
Anya: OK — please ping this thread when artwork is uploaded and when Triton posts tracking. We’ll finalize speaker order on Friday sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:
